column1: # Budgets of the execution-policy, runtime-detection and known-issue paths (A222, issue #172): the most external processes one run of the path may start on
# the fixture of tests/bench/exec-procs.mjs (a PATH shim counts them, the measured command itself included: no clock is read), and the most stdout bytes
# it may print. max_procs = the measured count (REPEAT=3 median) plus a margin of max(2, 25 percent); decide-dry is the whole shell `decide` (its policy step
# is one Node process now, the rest is shell until the dispatch package) and has a margin of 10 percent. max_bytes: the size of the output on that fixture
# ('-' for a path whose size is not a budget): a command may print less, never more. before = the shell form of 0.0.52 on the same fixture.
# tests/bench/exec-budgets.test.mjs fails above a row. Raise a row only with a decision in docs/decisions.md.
